headline: AI chips and Beijing's pledge powered a broad holiday-week recovery, but damaged trends and a loaded December calendar make Monday's follow-through the first real test

Chip selloff and hot core PCE rattled the tape at the open, but a partial recovery left the Dow green while the Nasdaq and SPX head into a holiday gap still nursing losses — Friday's abbreviated session is the first chance to find a floor
Monday's historic NVDA bounce is fading on Tuesday as chip stocks pull back and the market awaits Dell earnings and Wednesday's PCE data — the holiday clock is ticking
Huang is back and the AI trade violently reclaimed lost ground — but all indices remain below their moving averages and Wednesday's PCE print is the week's real verdict
AI unwind meets OpEx expiry and a fresh Trump policy shock — all four indices in correction, Monday opens with no gamma cushion and Wednesday's PCE as the next gate.
